Notes: your screenshot was used only as a style reference (tactile miniature world, wool clouds, tiny characters, soft lighting). Everything is drawn from scratch, and I left out the video’s on-screen credits. The product art is your photos. Only facts from the packs are used (weights, “com polpa da fruta”, “sabor limão”); the slogans are my own copy in Portuguese, so adjust them to your voice. The wobbly “boiling” texture is animated at ~8 frames per second to mimic stop-motion.
